dict.string: A download no longer takes the whole main thread. On a slower Mac the window's own title bar could stop answering while something was downloading - close, minimise, zoom, the toolbar button and the resize corner all did nothing - because the item page was being laid out again for every chunk that arrived. Progress is now reported at most five times a second whatever the speed of the download, and a progress tick moves the bar and its line of text instead of rebuilding the page. Measured on a PowerBook G3: the main thread went from never idle to idle about three quarters of the time.
